biotools.summary: nf-UnO is a Nextflow pipeline for identifying novel pathogens from metagenomic shotgun sequencing of foodborne outbreak specimens. It uses MIDAS2, metagenomic co-assembly, read mapping, and other tools to detect potential etiological agents.
